exercises.title: Face Yoga Exercises
exercises.subtitle: Scientifically designed facial muscle training for natural anti-aging

exercise1.name: Jawline Lift
exercise1.fullDesc: Define your jawline, eliminate double chin, and sculpt a perfect side profile

steps.title: Starting Position
steps.content: Sit straight or stand, relax your shoulders, keep your head centered.

steps.title: Chin Up
steps.content: Slowly raise your chin upward, feel the stretch in the front of your neck, hold for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Lip Pout
steps.content: Push your lips forward as if whistling, feel the contraction of your jaw muscles.

steps.title: Massage Combo
steps.content: Gently massage from your chin toward your ears to help lymphatic drainage.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.content: Repeat each movement 10-15 times, practice 2-3 sets daily.

tips: Movements should be slow and controlled
Better results when combined with massage
Visible results in 4-6 weeks with consistency

exercise2.name: Forehead Smoothing
exercise2.fullDesc: Reduce forehead wrinkles, lift your brows, and reveal a youthful glow

steps.title: Relax Forehead
steps.content: Place your fingertips on your forehead and press gently.

steps.title: Smooth Outward
steps.content: Gently smooth from the center of your brows toward your temples, repeat 10 times.

steps.title: Brow Lift
steps.content: Press below your eyebrows with your fingers and gently lift upward, hold for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Forehead Stretch
steps.content: Cross your hands on your forehead and gently stretch the scalp backward.

tips: Avoid pulling or tugging the skin too hard
Use massage oil or cream to reduce friction
Best results when done morning and evening

exercise3.name: Cheek Sculpting
exercise3.fullDesc: Lift the mid-face and restore youthful, plump apple cheeks

steps.title: Smile Exercise
steps.content: Raise the corners of your mouth, show your teeth, and smile, hold for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Puff Cheeks
steps.content: Close your mouth and puff air, moving it left and right to exercise cheek muscles.

steps.title: Finger Lift
steps.content: Gently lift and massage from the corners of your mouth toward your temples.

steps.title: Fish Face
steps.content: Pucker your lips like a fish, feel the contraction of your cheek muscles.

tips: Better results with facial massage cream
Keep movements gentle, avoid pulling skin
Consistent practice can improve facial sagging

exercise4.name: Eye Rejuvenation
exercise4.fullDesc: Eliminate eye bags and dark circles for brighter, more radiant eyes

steps.title: Eye Movement
steps.content: Close your eyes, roll them clockwise 10 times, then counterclockwise 10 times.

steps.title: Warm Compress
steps.content: Apply a warm towel to your eyes for 3 minutes to promote blood circulation.

steps.title: Acupressure Massage
steps.content: Use your ring finger to gently press acupressure points around the eyes, from inner to outer corners.

steps.title: Blink Exercise
steps.content: Blink rapidly 30 times, then close your eyes and rest for 10 seconds.

tips: Use eye cream with massage for better results
Drink plenty of water to keep skin hydrated
